nnls.solver: scipy.optimize.nnls on the full (17520 x n) system

settings.profile_matrix: M = [mu(Low)|mu(Normal)|mu(High)] / mean_h mu(Normal); negatives clipped to 0
settings.nmf: sklearn NMF r=5, solver cd, init nndsvd, frobenius, tol 1e-4, max_iter 2000, random_state 0, no regularisation
settings.kmedoids: sklearn_extra 0.1/0.2 KMedoids port: method alternate, init heuristic, Euclidean, max_iter 300
settings.features: min / max / mean of the half-hourly records in winter (Jan-Mar, Oct-Dec) and in summer (Apr-Sep), peak_hh / off_hh = mean over the 365 days of the argmax / argmin half-hour (0..47); each feature min-max rescaled to [0, 1]; k-medoids as above

a.label: PRIMARY: our 1,032 ToU + 1,032 Std, ERA5 temperatures, Tariffs.xlsx 'loc'

b.label: PAPER-SIZED: identified 1,007 ToU + in_1007_pair Std, ERA5, 'loc'

c.label: CLOSEST-TO-AUTHORS: identified 1,007 ToU (+1,007 Std), authors' temps + dummies

best_variant.name: causality smoothing GCV instead of LAML

definitions.D1: sklearn calinski_harabasz_score, observations = households, Y(i) = the household's record vector
definitions.D2: paper eqs. (3)-(5) literally: (|I|-k) sum_l ||Y(C_l)-Y(I)||^2 / ((k-1) sum_l |C_l|^-1 sum_i ||Y(i)-Y(C_l)||^2)
definitions.D3: pooled 1-D records: every household x record is one observation labelled by its household's cluster
definitions.D4: observations = household-days with 48-dim daily profiles (special: non-special records set to 0)

series.std: records / household mean over the year
series.special: std records at Low-or-High slots only (2,160 slots for 'auth', 2,448 for 'loc')

relabel.relabel_rule: Hungarian on raw cluster-mean correlations (agrees with deviation and contingency matching)
